description: HJR 5001 passed the House sixty-two to five, then died in the Senate. It will not be on your ballot. I would have voted yes, and I will support filing it again in 2027.

title: Your Land Is Your Land: Where I Stand on Property Rights and Eminent Domain. Zac Martin for SD House 32
